I will keep this bean plot fairly simple because money is not plenty, and beans do not need much chemical fertilizer like maize. Since it is a small intercropped plot, I will rely more on manure, use my local seed, and spray for pests because insects can spoil beans badly here. I will not irrigate because I depend on the rains, and most of the work will be done by my household with a little hired help when needed.
